metadata.informationCutoffConfidence: reconstructed; original combine measurement timestamps unavailable
metadata.poolDefinition: Recorded combine participants only; not a complete draft-eligible population
metadata.poolWarning: Only 2020 combine rows are playable. Non-combine eligible and undrafted players are not represented; do not interpret as a complete scouting pool.
missingFields: individual name/school reconciliation to 2020 official invitee roster

primaryOrderSourceRecord.cutoffEvidence: PDF title, order table, and footer say as of April 15, 2020; press release says FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — APRIL 16, 2020.
primaryOrderSourceRecord.cacheFormat: verbatim text returned by official-page web extraction; not original HTTP bytes

metadata.orderVerification: Owner sequence comes from the contemporaneous primary order source; reversal comparison differed at 4 picks. Primary source sequence is authoritative.
metadata.orderWarning: PDF title, order table, and footer say as of April 15, 2020; press release says FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — APRIL 16, 2020.
metadata.compensatoryClassification: Exact compensatory flags from official order sources for 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026; unknown for 2019 and 2021.
metadata.attribution: Factual data from nflverse (combine, draft selections, games) and nflverse/nfldata (transactions); official NFL/Raiders pages used for source checks. No logos or photos used.

url.cacheFormat: verbatim text returned by official-page web extraction; not original HTTP bytes

metadata.referenceIsolation: actualPicks and post-cutoff games are historical references only; neither is included in prospect features
